work.text: Speaker catalog: Executive Vice President, CoreAI, Microsoft.

In October 2024, he joined Microsoft’s Senior Leadership Team as Executive Vice President of CoreAI, bringing deep expertise in engineering, product, and infrastructure to support CoreAI’s mission: Empower every developer to shape the future with AI.

As Vice President and Global Head of Engineering and Infrastructure at Facebook from 2009 to 2021, he led global teams that designed, developed, and operated the infrastructure powering Facebook’s products, supporting its growth from 300 million to more than 3 billion users.

angles: Discuss Henry's experiences building IP and entertainment companies powered by AI, like Animori and Metacomica, showing how AI drives creative innovation.

openers: Hi Jay, I’m Henry Finn from Unicorn Studios in San Francisco. I’m really interested in how Microsoft is empowering developers to build AI agents and would love to hear your thoughts on where the tech is headed.
